title: One Brain Cell At Home
source_story: At home, a couple becomes a tiny search party. She is looking for her phone while it is already in her hand. He is looking for the remote while it is already in his hand. They still check the sofa cushions together. The story is not about forgetfulness as advice; it is about the no-judgement comedy of home, where both people can be ridiculous and no one has to act smart.

format.native_output_rule: Generate both formats separately. Never resize, crop, pad, or extend one output into the other.

identity_reference_selection.rule: Do not dump every identity image into a carousel prompt. Treat identity_images/ as a candidate library, then use a small curated bundle for each run.
identity_reference_selection.guidance: For best results, pass 2-4 --identity-image paths that match the story. Auto-discovery is a fallback that keeps prompts small, not a promise that every image in identity_images/ will be attached.

successful_carousel_standard.rule: Build a public identity mirror with concrete couple receipts, active Zuv care, an emotional reversal, and a send/save thesis; stage the story in visible actions before choosing poster text; do not optimize for keywords.
successful_carousel_standard.open_reasoning_policy: Expose the real goal and selection logic; do not optimize for keywords or let slide copy substitute for staged story action.
successful_carousel_standard.prompt_rule: Prompts must prove relationship behavior through stage-scene Aachu/Zuv action; text completes the scene instead of carrying it.

carousel story director persona before writing/designing
carousel_story_director_persona.rule: Before any hook, slide copy, caption, visual direction, prompt, or image handoff, confirm hook, setup, proof, escalation, bridge, active Zuv role, earned ending, and send/save reason.

concept_summary.human_truth: The safest kind of home is where both people can be ridiculous without anyone becoming the joke alone.
concept_summary.emotional_arc: Public one-brain-cell hook -> Aachu phone setup -> gentle reveal -> Zuv remote reversal -> equal reveal -> useless sofa search -> no-judgement home thesis.
